newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.069pts to 102.660.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.069pts to 102.660.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.069 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.660, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.071 points to 2.528 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.028 points to 99.313, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.457 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 2.306 points to 1,057.163.
